title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
title_zh: SKILL.PNG：在像素空间学习智能体技能
abstract_en: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing Skill.png: a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that Skill.png significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. Skill.png thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png
abstract_zh: 智能体通常通过上下文中的自然语言指令来适应新任务，但文本的离散性使其难以直接进行梯度优化，而微调得到的能力又往往绑定于特定模型。Skill.png 将技能表示为图像输入：在冻结视觉语言模型（VLM）参数的情况下，通过视觉编码器反向传播，用梯度下降直接优化图像像素。同一张技能图像也可针对多个 VLM 联合优化。在涵盖 4 个 VLM 和 4 个基准的 16 种评测设置中，Skill.png 在 9 种设置下显著优于由前沿大语言模型（LLM）优化的先进文本技能，推理时仅需 64–256 个图像 token，而文本技能约需 900–2000 个文本 token。联合优化文本与图像可进一步提升表现；针对多个 VLM 联合优化的技能图像可在参与优化的模型之间迁移。
key_points_zh: 冻结 VLM 参数，只更新输入图像的像素，让智能体技能可直接通过梯度下降优化。
在 16 种评测设置中，有 9 种显著优于先进文本技能；推理输入为 64–256 个图像 token，对照方法约需 900–2000 个文本 token。
联合优化文本与图像得到的混合技能，可进一步提升智能体表现。
同一张技能图像可在参与联合优化的 VLM 之间迁移；摘要未报告其在未参与优化模型上的迁移效果。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 用任务监督和验证集反馈优化冻结模型的可复用像素技能；对照与消融揭示了令牌开销、迁移和任务收益的权衡，但未改进优化机制本身。
